question: Is the calibrated composite target-state geometry shared enough across participants that a held-out target participant can receive it from the other seven with ZERO target imagery (dense target PERCEPTION calibration allowed)?

allowed_target_input: target native ROI responses to those anchors

global_identity_holdout: reuse 6 sealed outer folds; the 2 held-out imagery identities per fold excluded from imagery calibration for target AND all 7 donors (donors use only the same 10 outer-training identities); prevents test-identity leakage via transfer

donor_geometry.within: Z_d=W_d.T delta_native_d (10 train ids); SVD; top r_s (=target r_best) directions; require rank>=r_s; B_IN_d=W_d U_d[:, :r_s]
donor_geometry.outside: delta_out_d = delta_d - W_d(W_d.T delta_d); stack 10; SVD; D=2; B_OUT_d; no M/T/D search
donor_geometry.rank_matched_to_target: use TARGET comparison rank r_s for every donor

vision_transport_state.anchors: canonical 512 O2.3A-RD perception images (globally exclude NSD-Imagery ids); B0 lineage; same ROI voxels; same scaling
vision_transport_state.A_s: 512 x V_s native anchor response matrix, SAME anchor-image row order across participants (from sealed cached union centroids sliced to ROI voxels)

anchor_operators.C_s: A_s W_s (512 x K) perception-support fingerprint operator
anchor_operators.E_s: A_s - (A_s W_s) W_s.T (512 x V) dense-perception residual anchor; require E_s W_s ~0 (<=1e-10 rel)

fingerprints.within: F_IN_d = A_d B_IN_d (512 x r_s) -> orthonormalize span -> Q_IN_d (subspace only, sign-invariant)
fingerprints.outside: F_OUT_d = E_d B_OUT_d (512 x 2) -> orthonormalize -> Q_OUT_d (require rank 2)

donor_consensus.within: P_FP_IN = (1/7) sum_d Q_IN_d Q_IN_d.T ; Q_SHARED_IN = top r_s eigvecs
donor_consensus.outside: P_FP_OUT = (1/7) sum_d Q_OUT_d Q_OUT_d.T ; Q_SHARED_OUT = top 2 eigvecs

target_lift.within: U_RAW = pinv(C_s) Q_SHARED_IN (Moore-Penrose, frozen num-rank tol=eps*max(shape)*sigma_max, no ridge); orthonormalize rank r_s; B_IN_XSUB=W_s U_HAT; P_IN_XSUB=B B.T; range in col(W_s)
target_lift.outside: B_RAW = pinv(E_s) Q_SHARED_OUT; remove support leakage B_RAW - W_s(W_s.T B_RAW) (<=1e-10 rel cleanup else STOP); orthonormalize rank 2; P_OUT_XSUB; require W_s.T B_OUT_XSUB ~0

self_lift_ceiling.purpose: transfer interpretable ONLY if perception-anchor fingerprint recovers the TARGET's OWN full-resource calibrated geometry; ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC, not used to fit transfer
self_lift_ceiling.within: Q_SELF_IN=orth(A_s B_IN_ORACLE_s) lifted via C_s -> B_IN_SELF_LIFT
self_lift_ceiling.outside: Q_SELF_OUT=orth(E_s B_OUT_ORACLE_s) lifted via E_s -> B_OUT_SELF_LIFT

transport_adequacy.if_inadequate: VISION_ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_CEILING_INSUFFICIENT for that component; do NOT call it subject-specific

matched_null.type: deterministic ANCHOR-ROW permutation per donor (destroys cross-subject anchor-image correspondence; preserves donor subspace geometry + target transport operator)

inference.primary_family: 2 components x 2 ROIs = EXACTLY 4 tests (do NOT shrink if a component fails self-lift; mark O2_10_COMPONENT_TRANSFER_INFERENCE_INCOMPLETE and classify via transport ceiling)

component_sharedness: SUPPORTED iff ALL: self-lift adequate; median E_component>0; >=6/8 E>0; Holm reject; median TRANSFER_RECOVERY>=0.50; >=6/8 TRANSFER_RECOVERY>=0.50
zero_target_imagery_success: per ROI ZERO_TARGET_IMAGERY_COMPOSITE_TRANSFER_SUFFICIENT iff ALL: within SUPPORTED; outside SUPPORTED; median TOTAL_RECOVERY_XSUB>=0.50; >=6/8>=0.50; median COMPOSITE_TRANSFER_FRACTION>=0.50; >=6/8>=0.50 (no extra composite p-value)

two_stage_seal.STAGE_A: build/freeze vision extension -> provenance -> donor consensus -> freeze cross-subject predictions -> commit prediction hashes WITHOUT target imagery outcomes
two_stage_seal.STAGE_B: after Stage-A seal: open target oracle self-lift -> transport ceiling -> held-out eval -> matched null -> component inference -> composite classification

fingerprint_space_diagnostic.SIM(Pi,Pj): trace(Pi Pj)/rank (donor-pair projector similarity, within + outside); descriptive; distinguishes inconsistent donor fingerprints from a shared fingerprint not realizable in target native space

roi_status.COMPOSITE_GEOMETRY_ZERO_IMAGERY_TRANSFER: both components shared + composite zero-imagery criterion passes
roi_status.VISION_ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_CEILING_INSUFFIC: a required native component cannot be adequately self-lifted

program_status.SHARED_COMPOSITE_GEOMETRY_INSUFFICIENT_F: both have shared components but operational composite fails
program_status.COMPOSITE_TARGET_STATE_GEOMETRY_SUBJECT_: transport adequate in both but donor sharedness not supported in both
program_status.VISION_ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_INSUFFICIENT_FOR: transport ceiling blocks either primary ROI

positive_allowed: using only other participants' target-imagery geometry + dense perception calibration in the held-out target, the composite target-state geometry transferred to unseen target imagery identities
no target imagery used to construct the transferred geometry
claim_boundaries.transport_ceiling_allowed: the tested dense-perception anchor representation could not faithfully realize the target's own calibrated native target-state geometry, so failure of cross-subject native transfer cannot be attributed to lack of sharedness

next_gate.VISION_ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_INSUFFICIENT_FOR: O2.11 TARGET-STATE TRANSPORT REPRESENTATION DIAGNOSTIC (do NOT conclude non-sharedness)

o3_policy: even a positive O2.10 does NOT auto-authorize O3; must first establish reduced perception burden + stability
